mapper.select: SELECT scenario_keyword_no, scenario_no, keyword, weight, use_yn, frst_reg_dt, lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_keyword WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioId} ORDER BY weight DESC, keyword
SELECT scenario_keyword_no, scenario_no, keyword, weight, use_yn, frst_reg_dt, lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_keyword WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY weight DESC, keyword

SELECT k.scenario_keyword_no, k.scenario_no, k.keyword, k.weight, k.use_yn, k.frst_reg_dt, k.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_keyword k JOIN tb_scenario s ON s.scenario_no = k.scenario_no JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_no IS NOT NULL AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND k.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY k.scenario_no, k.weight DESC, k.keyword
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario_keyword (scenario_no, keyword, weight, use_yn) VALUES (#{scenarioNo}, #{keyword}, #{weight}, #{useYn})
